user.title: Add to Task
user.description: Add an area to manage its tasks, or the household overview with totals and a calendar of all tasks.

reconfigure.title: Change area
reconfigure.description: Move this task group to a different area.

data_description.area_id: Select a different area for this task group.
data_description.calendar_name: Custom name for the calendar entity. Leave empty to use the area name.
data_description.unified_calendar: Show this area's tasks only in the household calendar instead of a separate one. Needs a household overview.
data_description.warn_days: Tasks count as "due soon" this many days before they are due. Individual tasks can override this.

area.title: Add area
area.description: Choose the area of your home you'd like to manage recurring tasks for. Each area gets its own set of tasks.

data_description.area_id: The area where tasks will be tracked.
data_description.calendar_name: Custom name for the calendar entity. Leave empty to use the area name.
data_description.unified_calendar: Show this area's tasks only in the household calendar instead of a separate one. Needs a household overview.
data_description.warn_days: Tasks count as "due soon" this many days before they are due. Individual tasks can override this.

household.title: Household overview
household.description: Adds totals across all areas (overdue, due today, due this week, due soon) and one calendar with the tasks of all areas. There can be only one.

data_description.calendar_name: Name of the calendar with all tasks.

reconfigure_household.title: Household overview
reconfigure_household.description: Adds totals across all areas (overdue, due today, due this week, due soon) and one calendar with the tasks of all areas. There can be only one.

data_description.calendar_name: Name of the calendar with all tasks.

abort.already_configured: This area already has task management set up.

user.title: Add task
user.description: Set up a new recurring household task. Choose how often it should repeat.

data_description.name: A short, descriptive name like "Vacuum living room" or "Water plants".
data_description.interval_days: How many days between each occurrence of this task.
data_description.description: Optional notes or instructions for whoever does the task.
data_description.icon: Choose an icon to visually represent this task.
data_description.unassigned: Enable if no specific person is responsible. Disable to assign people in the next step.
data_description.warn_days: Overrides the area's warn days for this item. Leave empty to use the area value.
data_description.points: How much work the task is. The ranking counts points instead of completions, and the workload rotation gives tasks to whoever did the least recently. 1 if all tasks are about equal.

assignees.title: Assign people (optional)
assignees.description: Choose who is responsible for this task and how to rotate between them.

data_description.assignees: Pick one or more people to rotate through.
data_description.rotation_mode: How to pick the next person when the task is completed.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Mark a task as completed and advance the assignee rotation.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The task sensor or button entity to mark as complete.

completed_at.name: Completed at
completed_at.description: When the task was actually completed. Defaults to now. The next due date is calculated from this time. Cannot be in the future.

reset_task.name: Reset task
reset_task.description: Reset a task's completion history and rotation state.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The task sensor or button entity to reset.

postpone_task.name: Postpone task
postpone_task.description: Push the due date back without recording a completion. History, ranking and rotation stay unchanged.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The task sensor or button entity to postpone.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days to postpone. Counts from the current due date, or from today if the task is overdue.

undo_completion.name: Undo completion
undo_completion.description: Undo the most recently recorded completion of a task. Restores who was responsible, the rotation and a postponement.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The task sensor or button entity.

get_history.name: Get history
get_history.description: Return the completion history of a task, newest first, with the days between completions and how often it was done within its interval.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: The task sensor or button entity.

limit.name: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of completions to return.

set_away.name: Set away
set_away.description: Mark a person as away. The rotation skips them: tasks they were up for go to the next person, and they are not assigned anything until they are back. If everyone is away, the nominal assignee stays responsible.

start.name: Start
start.description: First day away. Defaults to today.

end.name: End
end.description: Last day away. Leave empty to stay away until cleared.

clear_away.name: Clear away
clear_away.description: Mark a person as present again.

completed_at_in_future.message: The completion time must not be in the future.

nothing_to_undo.message: There is no completion to undo. Only the most recently recorded completion can be undone, and not after a reset.

not_a_task.message: This is not a task entity of the Task integration.

away_end_before_start.message: The end date must not be before the start date.

away_already_over.message: The end date is in the past, so the person would never be away.
